items.badge_description:
Hoppy Hazy IPA Day! 

For the uninitiated, Sierra Nevada had the brilliant idea to create a day of celebration for hazies back in 2023! This year, we’re excited to introduce our third iteration of the Hazy IPA Day badge. 

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!

What happens when you take two or more amazing breweries, throw them into the tank and let them ferment together? An amazing collaboration beer, that’s what! Cheers to working together to create the perfect flavor. That's 360 different beers that have been brewed as a collaboration.  Try 5 more for Level 73!
